sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Tam Lin is a British folk hero. He is one of the best known fairies of the border country. The queen of Fairyland trapped him. A girl named Janet loved him. She tried to free him. On Samhain night she held him as the Wild Hunt rode past. He changed into an eel, a bear, a lion, and a spike of fire. Janet would not let go. She freed him from his spell.

okr.objective: Describe Tam Lin, a famous British fairy hero.
key_results: Tam Lin was a fairy caught by the queen of Fairyland.
A girl named Janet freed him from his spell.
